notes: Added missing schema/contract, API exposure, tool routing integration, and test coverage stories for FEAT-6.

stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for consent capture, tier transitions, and storage permissions, ensuring strict validation of inputs and outputs across the consent workflow.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose FastAPI endpoints for consent capture, upgrade to Tier 2, and consent status retrieval, ensuring integration with ConsentService and consistent response contracts.

stories.title: Tool Router Consent Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate consent checks into the tool_router to ensure that all tool invocations involving storage or identifiable data validate consent tier before execution.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Test Suite
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering consent capture, tier transitions, de-identification enforcement, API responses, and failure cases (missing or insufficient consent).
